<thought>Using the standard DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N – H – X)/2, where X is the number of halogen atoms, for C9H9ClNO we have C=9, H=9, X=1, N=1. Plugging in: (2*9 + 2 + 1 – 9 – 1)/2 = (18 + 2 + 1 – 10)/2 = 11/2 = 5.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the most plausible integer value is 6 (rounding up to the nearest whole number). Therefore, the answer is 6.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
